name: What is the difference between a drop-in and an undermount kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a drop-in and an undermount kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference between a drop-in (top-mount) and an undermount kitchen sink lies in their installation method and appearance. A drop-in sink has a rim that rests on top of the countertop, making installation simpler and often more budget-friendly. An undermount sink is installed beneath the countertop, creating a seamless look and making it easier to wipe crumbs directly into the sink. While undermount sinks offer a sleeker aesthetic and easier cleaning, they typically require solid surface countertops and more complex installation. Consider both the aesthetic and functional trade-offs for your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: A drop-in sink rests on the countertop with a visible rim, while an undermount sink is installed beneath for a seamless look and easier cleaning. Undermounts typically require solid countertops.
